text: Kuturmi is a stable indigenous language of Nigeria. It belongs to the Niger-Congo language family. The language is used as a first language by all in the ethnic community. It is not known to be taught in schools.

title: Kuturmi language
text: Kuturmi, also known as Ada or Ibiro-Ikryo (ISO 639-3: khj), is a Benue-Congo language of the Niger-Congo family, spoken by 10,000–20,000 people primarily in central Nigeria's Kaduna State.
